dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今日も遅刻、欠席ともになし――と。｛さすが／流石｝だ
　ね」

暦先生が出欠をとるなか、疲れた表情の学生達
が、教科書とにらめっこしている。
dialogues.en:
As Koyomi-sensei took the attendance, the tired students
continued burying their heads in their textbooks.
dialogues.text:
As Koyomi-sensei took the attendance, the tired students
continued burying their heads in their textbooks.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まっ、あたしにも身に覚えはあるがね……。
　講師になると悲しいよ……今日で最後だから、
　頑張りな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I still have memories of this... a teacher's sadness,
you could say. It's almost over, so work hard everyone."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I still have memories of this... a teacher's sadness,
you could say. It's almost over, so work hard everyone."

dialogues.jp: 週番に号令をかけさせ、教室から出て行く。
dialogues.en: After the weekly duty's signal, she left the room.
dialogues.text: After the weekly duty's signal, she left the room.

dialogues.jp: 早く今日という日が終わって欲しい……。
dialogues.en: Today should hurry up and be over with already...
dialogues.text: Today should hurry up and be over with already...

dialogues.jp:
昨日に引き続き、遅刻欠席なし。まあ、試験だ
しな。
dialogues.en:
Following from yesterday, there were no latecomers. Well,
it's the exam period, after all.
dialogues.text:
Following from yesterday, there were no latecomers. Well,
it's the exam period, after all.

dialogues.jp:
一日の始まりになんだが、早く今日という日が
終ってほしい。
dialogues.en:
As the day starts, I wish for it to be over as quickly as
possible.
dialogues.text:
As the day starts, I wish for it to be over as quickly as
possible.
